results.rationale: The shoe silhouette, heel, viewpoint and pale background are preserved, with a small change to the tan lining texture. The red exterior is fully changed to glossy black, accurately following the instruction. The edited shoe has coherent edges, realistic patent-leather reflections and natural grounding shadows.

The river valley, sky and banks remain recognizable, but extra distant boats are introduced and tree textures change visibly. A Chinese-style boat is added in the river, but it has a rigid pavilion cabin rather than the expected rounded black Wu-peng canopy. The regional boat concept is only partly matched. Several distant boats appear to sit on grass, a noticeable spatial-coherence defect in the otherwise plausible landscape.
